module: Mesh quality presets (shape level of detail), consumed by graphicsQualityGroup. Each level sets $pref::TS::detailAdjust and $pref::TS::skipRenderDLs.
notes: skipRenderDLs is 0 at all levels. No onApply hook.

qualityLevels.desc: Levels Lowest (detailAdjust 0.5), Low (0.75), Normal (1.0), High (1.5), Ultra (2.0), key $pref::TS::detailAdjust; $pref::TS::skipRenderDLs = 0 everywhere.
